{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

df_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify rows with invalid revenue (NaN)
invalid_rows = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'].isnull()]

# Exclude these rows from the total revenue calculation
df_valid = df_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

total_revenue = df_valid['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
